name: volumio-stream-watchdog
description: Keeps your web radio playing: reissues a stopped stream, falls back to a shuffled local playlist, and resumes the stream when it returns.
author: josemathias

volumio_info.details: Watches your web radio and keeps it playing. Every few seconds it checks what the player is actually doing: if the stream has stopped, it reissues it; if that does not help, it switches to a curated local Volumio playlist, always shuffled; while the playlist plays it checks the stream and resumes it as soon as it is back. Because it looks at the player itself instead of waiting for events, a stream that fails to restart after an outage cannot go unnoticed.
volumio_info.changelog: 2.0.0 — Rewritten as a single check loop, so no recovery step can wait forever; the offline playlist is always shuffled, first track included; restore tries that fail back off up to 10 min
